responsibilities: Design and implement AI/ML systems from concept to production, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance at enterprise scale
Develop and maintain LLM-powered applications including prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks
Build evaluation frameworks to measure model quality, accuracy, latency, and hallucination rates with automated regression testing
Implement guardrail systems for responsible AI deployment including content filtering, prompt injection prevention, and output validation
Optimize model inference performance through quantization, caching, batching strategies, and hardware-aware optimizations
Architect scalable AI platform infrastructure including model serving, feature stores, and real-time data pipelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, data scientists, and researchers to translate business requirements into AI solutions
Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems with vector databases, semantic search, and context management
Build monitoring and observability systems for AI applications tracking model performance, drift detection, and operational metrics
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering culture through code reviews, design docs, and technical knowledge sharing
Drive adoption of best practices in AI engineering including CI/CD for models, A/B testing frameworks, and automated quality gates
Participate in on-call rotation for production AI systems, troubleshooting incidents and ensuring high availability
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and tools to continuously improve the AI platform capabilities
Implement security and compliance requirements for AI systems including data privacy, access controls, and audit logging
Contribute to technical roadmap planning and architecture decisions for the AI/ML platform evolution
Design and implement machine learning models for classification, regression, recommendation, and ranking tasks at scale
Build end-to-end ML pipelines including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment
Develop real-time ML inference systems with low-latency serving requirements and auto-scaling capabilities

Implement security and compliance requirements for AI systems including data privacy, access controls, and audit logging
Contribute to technical roadmap planning and architecture decisions for the AI/ML platform evolution
Design and implement machine learning models for classification, regression, recommendation, and ranking tasks at scale
Build end-to-end ML pipelines including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment
Develop real-time ML inference systems with low-latency serving requirements and auto-scaling capabilities

responsibilities: Design and implement AI/ML systems from concept to production, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance at enterprise scale
Develop and maintain LLM-powered applications including prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks
Build evaluation frameworks to measure model quality, accuracy, latency, and hallucination rates with automated regression testing
Implement guardrail systems for responsible AI deployment including content filtering, prompt injection prevention, and output validation
Optimize model inference performance through quantization, caching, batching strategies, and hardware-aware optimizations
Architect scalable AI platform infrastructure including model serving, feature stores, and real-time data pipelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, data scientists, and researchers to translate business requirements into AI solutions
Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems with vector databases, semantic search, and context management
Build monitoring and observability systems for AI applications tracking model performance, drift detection, and operational metrics
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering culture through code reviews, design docs, and technical knowledge sharing
Drive adoption of best practices in AI engineering including CI/CD for models, A/B testing frameworks, and automated quality gates
Participate in on-call rotation for production AI systems, troubleshooting incidents and ensuring high availability
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and tools to continuously improve the AI platform capabilities
Implement security and compliance requirements for AI systems including data privacy, access controls, and audit logging
Contribute to technical roadmap planning and architecture decisions for the AI/ML platform evolution
Design and implement machine learning models for classification, regression, recommendation, and ranking tasks at scale
Build end-to-end ML pipelines including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment
Develop real-time ML inference systems with low-latency serving requirements and auto-scaling capabilities

responsibilities: Design and implement AI/ML systems from concept to production, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance at enterprise scale
Develop and maintain LLM-powered applications including prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks
Build evaluation frameworks to measure model quality, accuracy, latency, and hallucination rates with automated regression testing
Implement guardrail systems for responsible AI deployment including content filtering, prompt injection prevention, and output validation
Optimize model inference performance through quantization, caching, batching strategies, and hardware-aware optimizations
Architect scalable AI platform infrastructure including model serving, feature stores, and real-time data pipelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, data scientists, and researchers to translate business requirements into AI solutions
Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems with vector databases, semantic search, and context management
Build monitoring and observability systems for AI applications tracking model performance, drift detection, and operational metrics
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering culture through code reviews, design docs, and technical knowledge sharing
Drive adoption of best practices in AI engineering including CI/CD for models, A/B testing frameworks, and automated quality gates
Participate in on-call rotation for production AI systems, troubleshooting incidents and ensuring high availability
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and tools to continuously improve the AI platform capabilities
Implement security and compliance requirements for AI systems including data privacy, access controls, and audit logging
Contribute to technical roadmap planning and architecture decisions for the AI/ML platform evolution
Design and implement machine learning models for classification, regression, recommendation, and ranking tasks at scale
Build end-to-end ML pipelines including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment
Develop real-time ML inference systems with low-latency serving requirements and auto-scaling capabilities

responsibilities: Design and implement AI/ML systems from concept to production, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance at enterprise scale
Develop and maintain LLM-powered applications including prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks
Build evaluation frameworks to measure model quality, accuracy, latency, and hallucination rates with automated regression testing
Implement guardrail systems for responsible AI deployment including content filtering, prompt injection prevention, and output validation
Optimize model inference performance through quantization, caching, batching strategies, and hardware-aware optimizations
Architect scalable AI platform infrastructure including model serving, feature stores, and real-time data pipelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, data scientists, and researchers to translate business requirements into AI solutions
Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems with vector databases, semantic search, and context management
Build monitoring and observability systems for AI applications tracking model performance, drift detection, and operational metrics
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering culture through code reviews, design docs, and technical knowledge sharing
Drive adoption of best practices in AI engineering including CI/CD for models, A/B testing frameworks, and automated quality gates
Participate in on-call rotation for production AI systems, troubleshooting incidents and ensuring high availability
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and tools to continuously improve the AI platform capabilities
Implement security and compliance requirements for AI systems including data privacy, access controls, and audit logging
Contribute to technical roadmap planning and architecture decisions for the AI/ML platform evolution
Design and implement machine learning models for classification, regression, recommendation, and ranking tasks at scale
Build end-to-end ML pipelines including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment
Develop real-time ML inference systems with low-latency serving requirements and auto-scaling capabilities
